d: An anthropomorphic fox with rust-orange fur, a large bushy white-tipped tail, and a white beard, appearing as a mature elder with small, curious emerald-green eyes. The body is small and stout, wearing a wide-brimmed deep teal hat with gold trim, a matching teal and gold waist-cape, and a brown leather shoulder strap with a pouch. Visible accessories include large circular silver-rimmed glasses perched on the forehead and a small wooden branch with green leaves held in the hand. BODY COLOR: Rust-orange and white LEGS: Digitigrade with brown paws
